/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p visualization && touch visualization/.keep && /opt/conda/bin/pvpython - <<'PY' > visualization/probe.log 2>&1
from paraview.simple import *
files=['/workspace/cloud/cloud1.vti','/workspace/cloud/cloud2.vti','/workspace/cloud/cloud3.vti']
diags=[]
for fn in files:
 r=XMLImageDataReader(FileName=[fn])
 s=TTKTopologicalSimplificationByPersistence(Input=r);s.InputArray=['POINTS','Scalars_'];s.PersistenceThreshold=0.5;s.ThresholdIsAbsolute=1;s.PairType=2
 p=TTKPersistenceDiagram(Input=s);p.ScalarField=['POINTS','Scalars_'];p.Saddlemaximumdiagramdimensiond1=1;p.EmbedinDomain=1
 p.UpdatePipeline();print('diagram',fn,p.GetDataInformation().GetDataSetTypeAsString(),p.GetDataInformation().GetNumberOfPoints(),p.GetDataInformation().GetNumberOfCells())
 diags.append(p)
g=GroupDatasets(Input=diags)
t=TTKTrackingFromPersistenceDiagrams(Input=g);t.Assignmentmethod=0;t.Persistencethreshold=0.5
t.UpdatePipeline()
print('ports',t.GetNumberOfOutputPorts())
for i in range(t.GetNumberOfOutputPorts()):
 o=OutputPort(t,i);o.UpdatePipeline(); info=o.GetDataInformation();print('out',i,info.GetDataSetTypeAsString(),info.GetNumberOfPoints(),info.GetNumberOfCells(),info.GetNumberOfDataSets())
 print('pointarrays',[info.GetPointDataInformation().GetArrayInformation(j).GetName() for j in range(info.GetPointDataInformation().GetNumberOfArrays())])
PY
 tail -60 visualization/probe.log"

Completed the visualization and saved reproducible outputs:
